free_text_notes.physician_note: 84-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes, admitted 5/9 with left thalamic infarct with sensory deficits. MRI confirmed small infarct; no hemorrhagic conversion. The patient experienced mild constipation during the stay. This was managed with a standard laxative and resolved before discharge. No further action is needed. The patient mentioned that they have been stressed at work recently. This was noted. It does not affect the clinical discharge plan and the patient confirmed they feel ready to go home.
